fields.label: Auto-Calculate for Coniferous Forest
fields.help: Check the box to allow the model to calculate the fraction of wet deposition that is intercepted by coniferous tree needles. This feature is not typically used.

fields.label: Static Value for Coniferous Forest
fields.help: Enter the fraction of wet deposition that is intercepted by coniferous tree needles. The default value of 0.2 is professional judgement.
